Upstream Perou Lab PAM50 research code, kept here as pinned git SUBMODULES (not
copies) so the provenance is an exact, tamper-evident upstream commit. These are
reference-only — they are never sourced at runtime; the packaged, refactored
implementations live in the package's R/ (repo root).

Submodules (authors: Joel S. Parker & Charles M. Perou, Perou Lab):

  PAM50_classifier              https://github.com/perou-lab/PAM50_classifier.git
                                pinned commit 45121d8d6bb01471155e1252591a6dbce1314307
                                PAM50_R/subtypePrediction_distributed.R  -> R/predict.R (transcribed)
                                PAM50_R/subtypePrediction_functions.R    -> R/perou_internal.R (verbatim)
                                                                         + R/perou_plots.R (myplot/pcaEA)
                                pam50_centroids.txt, annotation, calibration
                                medians, training set -> inst/extdata/

  PAM50_ER_HER2_normalization   https://github.com/perou-lab/PAM50_ER_HER2_normalization.git
                                pinned commit 9ba84ebc131a58a18446e235c9422d9802f56671
                                SIGMA.txt (Zhao4 quantiles) -> inst/extdata/SIGMA.txt

To populate them in a fresh clone/worktree (optional — only needed to inspect the
upstream sources, never to run intrinsix):

  git submodule update --init vendor/perou-lab/PAM50_classifier \
                              vendor/perou-lab/PAM50_ER_HER2_normalization

PAM50 assay protocol: Arantxa Fernandez-Martinez (Perou Lab).
Licence of the upstream repositories: to be confirmed before public release.
